verdict.rationale: Azure documents infrastructure export paths (Terraform 'export resources to HCL', ARM/Bicep declarative templates, REST APIs and CLI for programmatic access) which support exporting resource configurations in open/declarative formats, but there is no evidence of a comprehensive data-export or account-portability tool covering actual data stored in Azure services (Blob, SQL, Cosmos DB, etc.) in open formats for a full platform exit. Missing for 10: dedicated data-export/migration tooling for stored data (not just infra config), documented data portability guarantees, and independent confirmation that a user can fully extract all data and leave without lock-in friction.
